title: 存储涨价压顶：小米手机毛利扛住了，接下来几个季度还扛得住吗？
speaker: Yu Chen-Deng

segments.en: But their take, HSBC's head of China technology and auto's research, Yu Chen-Deng, you're doing this great to have you.
segments.zh: 汇丰中国科技与汽车研究主管Yu Chen-Deng，感谢你的参与。

segments.en: Why do you think the stock is reacting so positively to these earnings? So mostly because of the quality smartphone margin resilience.
segments.zh: 为何股价对财报反应积极？主要因智能手机利润率韧性。

segments.en: So I think that has been the key focus. Market used to be worried about the higher memory price has been continuous due pressure down the consumer electronics,
segments.zh: 这是关键焦点。市场曾担忧内存涨价持续压制消费电子，

segments.en: especially the smartphones. But the Xiaomi's third quarter demonstrated they do have the margin.
segments.zh: 尤其是智能手机。但小米三季度证明其利润率。

segments.en: They do demonstrate strong margin resilience under these pressure thanks to higher pricing and also a better mix.
segments.zh: 他们证明在压力下利润率强劲，得益于提价和产品结构优化。

segments.en: How do you foresee where memory prices of the cycle goes moving forward?
segments.zh: 你预计内存价格周期未来如何？

segments.en: Have you seen signs of that peaking now? So we would say from a Xiaomi perspective, the pressure might still remain.
segments.zh: 有见顶迹象吗？从小米角度看，压力可能仍存。

segments.en: So for the 2027, for the few years, the memory price inflation might be getting higher now,
segments.zh: 2027年及未来几年，内存涨价可能更高，

segments.en: but the pressure remains due there. So for the supply demand situation to get in structure lease, that could be 2028.
segments.zh: 但压力仍在。供需结构改善可能要到2028年。

segments.en: So for the coming a few quarters, the cost of pressure remains.
segments.zh: 未来几个季度，成本压力持续。
